slack_messages.text: Platform Redesign approved for $500K, starting immediately
Great! I'm allocating 4 engineers to this
Which four? Everyone on the Platform team is also tagged on API v3 or tech debt work right now.
Ian, Jack, Diana and Karen. We'll sort out the overlap as we go.
Heads up, API v3 is mid-flight. I can split time but I can't go full-time on Platform.
Happy to dig into Phase 1 this week. Is the 6 month timeline in Bob's spec still the plan?
Yes. Spec v1 is the source of truth: new DB, new API, 6 months.
Actually, can we start with 2? We have other priorities
+1 to starting smaller. Tech Debt Cleanup keeps slipping as it is.
Regulatory requirement just surfaced. Security Audit needs to be complete by Q2. Requirements doc is posted, and I'll be pulled off Platform for the scoping.
Disagree. We need 4 to hit the timeline
Then who covers the Infrastructure Migration dependencies? Harry is already waiting on us.
Confirming PROJ-004 is blocked until Platform delivers. We're sitting idle.
Finance just called, budget cut to $250K due to Q1 numbers
Is that final or just a proposal?
Final. Carol signed off today.
That's impossible. We can't do it with 2 engineers AND half budget
Agree with Bob. A full rewrite on half the money isn't realistic. FYI API v3 also just got cut from $200K to $100K, so I'm trimming scope and extending that timeline.
What if we keep the existing DB and only touch what hurts most: query performance, caching, API latency?
That's not the redesign I specced. But I'd rather ship something than nothing. Let me think.
OK, let's descope. Focus on performance only, not architecture
Housekeeping: moving PROJ-001 to Diana for now and splitting the performance work into PROJ-009. Bob stays on as exec sponsor.
Fine. Sponsor only. Diana, you own the plan.
I need about 2 weeks on the audit scoping. Platform can have Jack, Diana and Karen meanwhile.
I volunteer to lead. Let's make it work with $250K and 3 engineers
Draft of the v2 spec is in the doc. Keeps the existing DB, extends the API.
Diana, great. Confirmed. New timeline: 8 months instead of 6
Thanks Alice. Tech Spec v2 is published and PROJ-009 tracks the work.
Separate news: Internal Tools Overhaul is greenlit at $80K with Leo leading. The goal is to speed up the Platform work.
With Platform on an 8 month plan, PROJ-004 slips again. Pushing to April 30 and flagging it at risk. Still blocked on Platform.
Mobile is cancelled, Analytics is going to a vendor. Does that make Platform the only big bet now?
Platform Redesign budget restored, $400K. Series B depends on it.
Great news. Can we bring back a 4th engineer?
Yes, Ian rejoins once audit scoping wraps. Keep the performance-first scope though; we revisit the DB in Phase 2.
Progress: p95 API latency is down 31% after the caching work. Phase 1 is on track for the end of May investor demo.
Mobile App v2 greenlit for Q2 launch
Great. Design kickoff Monday. I need to audit the component library first.
Do we have the refreshed brand assets yet? Design depends on them.
Marketing committed, got the budget
Campaign kicks off in May and we're already telling partners Q2.
Early flows are more complex than scoped: offline mode, biometric auth, tablet layouts.
Noted. I'll raise it with Alice.
Please don't let design slip. Partner briefings are already booked.
Actually, design is taking longer. Let's target Q3
Q3? Our partner commitments say Q2.
Agreed. Better to delay than launch broken
Updated PROJ-002: design complete moves to May 31, launch to Q3.
Design is about 40% done. Q3 is realistic if scope holds.
Reconsidering. Market window closing. Can we do Q2?
No way. Design is complex. Q3 minimum.
Agree with Eve. A rushed launch means rework later.
A competitor just announced a mobile app. We're losing the window.
I hear you, Frank. Let me weigh it against Platform.
Cancelling Mobile App v2. Focusing on Platform instead
WHAT? We promised this to the market!
I've set PROJ-002 to cancelled. What do we tell the design team?
I know, but Platform is more strategic
Then someone needs to own the partner conversation. I'm not doing it alone.
I'll join the partner calls. Frank, draft the talking points.
Archiving the Mobile v2 Figma files. Reusable components are moving into the design system.
Small analytics dashboard for internal use
Started on the revenue and retention views using Omar's warehouse tables.
Can we expand this to customer-facing?
Sure, scope would increase 3x
Do it. Critical for Series B
Noted. Customer Portal (PROJ-011) was greenlit too and will need this dashboard's data, so I'll plan both together.
We're way behind. This is bigger than initial scope
Don't care. We committed to Series B partners
Found a vendor solution. Could buy instead of build?
Cost? Timeline?
Same cost, 2 months faster, half the work
Interesting. Send me the vendor contract terms and let me think on it.
Switch to vendor. Analytics Dashboard is now a ticket, not a project
Closing out PROJ-003 as resolved (vendor SaaS). Integration work will be tracked in a new ticket, with Priya and Omar on SSO and data feeds.
Vendor sandbox is up and the first data feed is connected.
2026 priorities: Platform Redesign, Mobile v2, Security Audit
Q1 numbers came in. Cost cutting needed.
Cutting budgets. What's non-negotiable?
Platform Redesign is critical. Don't cut that.
Cutting it from $500K to $250K
That doesn't work. Let me rebuild the plan
New strategy: Focus on Platform, delay Mobile, outsource Analytics
Correction to the above: Mobile v2 is cancelled, not delayed. Analytics goes to the vendor.
Revised budget approved
Details: Platform $400K, Security Audit $150K, API v3 $100K, Internal Tools $80K. Mobile v2 funds released.
